会产生文件系统改动的指令 = 4（第 [4, 5, 6, 7] 层）

code:
# 一个极简但真实的 Dockerfile 解析器：处理行续接（\）、注释、指令归一，
# 并回答「哪些指令会产生文件系统改动」「最终镜像有多少层」。

DOCKERFILE = r"""FROM python:3.13-slim
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY src/ ./src/
RUN groupadd -g 10001 app && useradd -u 10001 -g app app
EXPOSE 8000
USER 10001:10001
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s CMD python -c "import urllib.request;urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz')"
ENTRYPOINT []
CMD ["python", "src/app.py"]
"""

FS_CHANGING = ("RUN", "COPY", "ADD")
LAYER_SIZE = {"FROM": 45.0, "COPY": 0.1, "RUN": 95.0, "RUN#2": 0.3, "COPY#2": 0.4}


def parse(text):
    """处理 \\ 续接与 # 注释，返回 [(指令, 参数)]。"""
    logical = []
    buf = ""
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        line = raw.rstrip()
        if buf:
            buf = buf[:-1] + line.lstrip() if buf.endswith("\\") else buf
            if raw.rstrip().endswith("\\"):
                buf = line
                continue
            logical.append(buf)
            buf = ""
            continue
        if line.rstrip().endswith("\\"):
            buf = line
            continue
        logical.append(line)
    if buf:
        logical.append(buf)

    out = []
    for line in logical:
        s = line.strip()
        if not s or s.startswith("#"):
            continue
        parts = s.split(None, 1)
        out.append((parts[0].upper(), parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""))
    return out


instrs = parse(DOCKERFILE)
from collections import Counter
counter = Counter(ins for ins, _ in instrs)

print("=== Dockerfile 静态解析 ===")
print("指令条目数（续接已合并） = %d" % len(instrs))
print("指令分布: " + "  ".join("%s=%d" % (k, counter[k]) for k in sorted(counter)))
fs_layers = [i for i, (ins, _) in enumerate(instrs, 1) if ins in FS_CHANGING]
meta_layers = [i for i, (ins, _) in enumerate(instrs, 1) if ins not in FS_CHANGING]
print("会产生文件系统改动的指令 = %d（第 %s 层）" % (len(fs_layers), fs_layers))
print("只改元数据的指令         = %d（第 %s 层）" % (len(meta_layers), meta_layers))
print("最终镜像层数（经典构建器：每条指令一层）= %d" % len(instrs))
print("其中 0 字节的元数据层   = %d" % len(meta_layers))

base = 45.0
delta = 0.1 + 95.0 + 0.4 + 0.3
print()
print("体积估算: base %.1fMB + 各层改动 %.1fMB = %.1fMB" % (base, round(delta, 1), base + delta))

meta = {}
for ins, arg in instrs:
    if ins in ("FROM", "WORKDIR", "EXPOSE", "USER", "HEALTHCHECK", "CMD", "ENTRYPOINT"):
        meta.setdefault(ins, arg)
print()
print("基础镜像 = %s" % meta["FROM"])
print("工作目录 = %s" % meta["WORKDIR"])
print("暴露端口 = %s" % meta["EXPOSE"])
print("运行用户 = %s（非 root: %s）" % (meta["USER"], not meta["USER"].startswith("0") and not meta["USER"].startswith("root")))
print("健康检查 = %s" % meta["HEALTHCHECK"].split("CMD", 1)[-1].strip())
print("默认命令 = %s" % meta["CMD"])
print("显式清空 ENTRYPOINT: %s（这样 CMD 才是真正被执行的命令）" % (meta["ENTRYPOINT"].strip() == "[]"))
